title: Affine sign function evaluation
statement: For a sign $\sigma\in\{\pm1\}$ and vectors $\gamma,x\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the affine sign function at $x$ equals the real value of $\sigma$ times the Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$ evaluated at $x$.
